verdict.rationale: Zapier ships an official hosted MCP server (zapier.com/mcp) giving any MCP-compatible client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) governed access to 9,000+ apps/40,000+ actions with SOC2-certified, no-code setup, plus a local MCP server option via the CLI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server's reliability beyond vendor docs.
